# Ewok Micro-Edge & Mesh Protocol (Living Trunk)

* **Wire Header (`include/dandelion_protocol.h`):** 18-byte `dandelion_header_t` (`DANDELION_MAGIC = 0x44414E44`) and 577-byte `dandelion_tnpt_t`.
* **Rust + Julia IPC Bridge (`rust/` & `julia/`):** UNIX domain socket `/tmp/dandelion_mesh.sock` and UDP `DandelionTunnel` synchronized with `scripts/connect_dandyland.sh`.
* **Tuttle Bypass Topology:** Routes around institutional potential barriers $V(x)$ and simplicial $P(n) = 3^{n-1}$ triplicate deadlocks.
